##### Project general facts

Aark Terraces is a contemporary residential development located in Dubailand Residence Complex, designed to deliver a refined urban lifestyle with a resort-inspired atmosphere. The project features a modern architectural concept with clean lines and thoughtfully designed spaces, offering a collection of 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, many enhanced with private jacuzzis for an elevated living experience. The building stands as a stylish addition to the area, combining functionality with aesthetic appeal to meet the expectations of both end-users and investors.

Residents benefit from a wide range of premium amenities that create a balanced and vibrant lifestyle. The development includes an infinity swimming pool overlooking the city skyline, a fully equipped gym, outdoor yoga areas, and landscaped relaxation zones. Social and leisure facilities such as an outdoor cinema, BBQ areas, cabanas, and dedicated children’s play spaces further enhance the community feel, making it ideal for both families and young professionals seeking comfort and entertainment within one address.

The interiors are designed with attention to detail, featuring high-quality materials and elegant finishes throughout. Residences showcase porcelain flooring, oak veneer wall panels, and stylish kitchen cabinetry, complemented by refined bathroom fittings with porcelain surfaces and metal accents. The overall design creates a sophisticated yet comfortable ambiance, ensuring that each home reflects contemporary luxury and everyday practicality.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubailand is a sprawling and diverse community located in Dubai, offering a multitude of entertainment, leisure, and residential opportunities. This vibrant community is renowned for its wide range of attractions and experiences, making it a unique destination that caters to residents and visitors of all ages.

At the heart of Dubailand is its extensive array of world-class entertainment and leisure destinations. The community is home to numerous theme parks, including Dubai Parks and Resorts, which features Legoland, Motiongate, Bollywood Parks, and the immersive waterpark experience of Legoland Water Park. These attractions provide endless fun and entertainment for families, creating memorable experiences for both children and adults alike.

Dubailand also boasts a variety of sporting facilities and outdoor spaces, catering to the needs of sports enthusiasts and those seeking an active lifestyle. The community is home to renowned golf courses, tennis courts, cycling tracks, and expansive parks, providing opportunities for outdoor activities and leisurely pursuits.
